title: Delete Duplicate Folders in System
goal: Delete all folders having duplicate nonempty subtree structures in one simultaneous pass.
strategy: Canonical signatures describe each folder by sorted child names and child signatures. Mark every repeated nonempty signature before deleting anything, then collect paths whose ancestry contains no marked folder.
